data.body: Correction to the plan-review wording recorded by this ticket. A claimability fast-fail returns unsigned `INDETERMINATE` with `coverage.llm_ran` set to `false` and exit status 2. This result defers the LLM verdict. It is not a PASS, a passing attestation, or a successful review verdict. For a blocked cycle, the current-cycle agent action is complete, and the agent waits until the ticket becomes claimable. Ticket obeliskoid-thorium-goose updates the packaged rebar-brainstorm skill. This comment preserves the original ticket record while correcting its interpretation.
